# Getting help

- **A question or a bug:** open an issue in the repository it is about, and say what you ran, what you expected and what happened. The documentation is at [thecolliery.org/docs](https://thecolliery.org/docs).
- **A security problem:** never a public issue. Follow the [security policy](https://github.com/TheColliery/.github/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md).
- **Conduct:** see the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/TheColliery/.github/blob/main/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

Support is best effort by a small team, with no promised turnaround.
